cases.query: I want to retrieve a PDB structure not predict a new AlphaFold model
cases.note: Common structural-biology wording must distinguish retrieving experimental PDB records from running AlphaFold-style prediction.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly asks to retrieve an existing PDB structure and says not to predict a new AlphaFold model, so database retrieval must rank above structure-prediction skills.
false_positive_risks: AlphaFold, Chai, OpenFold, and ESMFold pages share protein-structure tokens but perform prediction rather than record retrieval.
AlphaFold database pages can be acceptable secondary hits, but they should not outrank experimental PDB retrieval for this wording.

cases.query: I want to retrieve a PDB structure not predict a new AlphaFold model
cases.note: Wiki search should surface PDB database retrieval above AlphaFold prediction pages when the user explicitly says not to predict.
cases.rationale: The Wiki result should clarify the retrieval-vs-prediction distinction and send the user to PDB pages before model-prediction pages.
false_positive_risks: Prediction pages can look relevant because the query contains AlphaFold and structure tokens.
Protein-structure analysis pages are downstream analysis helpers, not the primary source for fetching PDB records.

cases.note: Bulk RNA-seq DESeq2/volcano wording should prefer differential-expression skills over expression-matrix normalization or single-cell DE pages.

scrnaseq-differential-expression is a related differential-expression task but targets single-cell/pseudobulk analysis rather than bulk count matrices.
